svg.aria-label: Data Pilot agent structure: a question enters a pydantic-ai loop with schema knowledge, per-user memory and tools; the SQL it writes is checked by an sqlglot AST guard and then run as one governed read-only SELECT under Postgres row-level security; the rows go through a Pyodide WASM sandbox into a typed report that carries its own charts and SQL.

g.title: question — plain English, typed in chat, Slack or the webhook
the pydantic-ai loop — DeepSeek by default, Claude behind the same abstraction; tools are dbt-manifest schema knowledge, value lookup, per-user pgvector memory and make_chart
the SQL guard — shape check, keyword denylist, then an sqlglot AST walk that rejects DML/DDL hidden in a CTE and privileged functions like set_config
the governed action — one read-only SELECT, run as a read-only role under row-level security scoped to this user
the analysis sandbox — model-written pandas executed in Pyodide/WASM with no network and no filesystem
the answer — typed report objects streamed page by page over SSE, each carrying the query that produced it

path.title: only a query that clears the guard is ever executed

svg.text: graded G1–G3 · cross-family judge · every run traced
